I'm announcing v2 of my open source grants of $1,000USD to 35 awesome contributors. The themes:

① Agent skills & tools
Skills are now a valuable form of software, like Emil's world-class design eng work. Projects like 𝚙𝚐𝚋𝚘𝚝, 𝚔𝚗𝚒𝚙, 𝚞𝚗𝚕𝚒𝚐𝚑𝚝𝚑𝚘𝚞𝚜𝚎 create amazing AI engineering loops.

② Local AI
Projects like 𝚜𝚕𝚘𝚝𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚖, 𝙻𝚘𝚌𝚊𝚕𝙰𝙸, and 𝚌𝚘𝚕𝚒𝚋𝚛𝚒 are making inference not just a demo but for many a real and growing utility. Exciting to watch local AI unfold.

③ Performance
There's no excuse for software to be slow anymore. Projects like 𝚏𝚏𝚏 and 𝚝𝚊𝚔𝚞𝚖𝚒 leading with speed, compilers like 𝙿𝚎𝚛𝚛𝚢𝚃𝚂 and 𝚙𝚘𝚛𝚏𝚏𝚘𝚛 that can help us upgrade entire ecosystems to native, and 𝚐𝚙𝚞𝚒𝚡 pushing the GPU rendering speed frontier.

④ High quality foundations
AI is still at its best when it can reuse great components than regenerating every time from first principles. Lots of love to folks working on @shadcn, Svelte(kit), Nuxt, Node.js and security foundations.

⑤ Cool experiments
I couldn't resist donating to https://t.co/j9XATPFzV7, a 'Finance terminal in the terminal', or beautiful funky things like 𝚍𝚒𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛-𝚔𝚒𝚝.

🔗 https://t.co/tkCpYPkHxH

PS: These are personal, not affiliated with Vercel, and fully unconditional. If you are listed, I'll be DM'ing you or using your public contact info!

▲ ~/𝚛𝚊𝚞𝚌𝚑𝚐/𝚘𝚜𝚜-𝚐𝚛𝚊𝚗𝚝𝚜/ 𝚕𝚜▐ (v2)

我宣布第二期开源资助计划，将向 35 位杰出的贡献者提供 1000 美元的资助。主题如下：

① 智能体技能与工具

技能如今已成为一种宝贵的软件形式，例如 Emil 世界一流的设计工程作品。像 𝚙𝚐𝚋𝚘𝚝、𝚔𝚗𝚒𝚙 和 𝚞𝚗𝚕𝚒𝚐𝚑𝚝𝚑𝚘𝚞𝚜𝚎 这样的项目创造了令人惊叹的 AI 工程循环。

② 本地 AI

像 𝚜𝚕𝚘𝚝𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚖、𝙻𝚘𝚌𝚊𝚕𝙰𝙸 和 𝚌𝚘𝚕𝚒𝚋𝚛𝚒 这样的项目正在使推理不再仅仅是演示，而是对许多人来说真正且日益增长的实用工具。本地 AI 的发展令人兴奋。

③ 性能

软件运行缓慢已不再是借口。像 𝚏𝚏𝚏 和 𝚝𝚊𝚔𝚞𝚖𝚒 这样的项目引领着速度潮流，像 𝙿𝚎𝚛𝚛𝚢𝚃𝚂 和 𝚙𝚘𝚛𝚏𝚏𝚘𝚛 这样的编译器能够帮助我们将整个生态系统升级到原生应用，而 𝚐𝚙𝚞𝚒𝚡 则不断突破 GPU 渲染速度的极限。

④ 高质量的基础架构

人工智能的最佳状态仍然是能够重用优秀的组件，而不是每次都从头开始重新生成。向所有致力于 @shadcn、Svelte(kit)、Nuxt、Node.js 和安全基础架构的开发者们致以崇高的敬意。

⑤ 超酷的实验

我忍不住要给 https://t.co/j9XATPFzV7 捐款，比如“航站楼里的金融终端”，或者像 𝚍𝚒𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚛-𝚔𝚒𝚝 这样酷炫又有趣的东西。

🔗 https://t.co/tkCpYPkHxH

附注：这些都是我个人的捐赠，与 Vercel 无关，而且完全无条件。如果你在名单上，我会私信你或者使用你的公开联系方式！

tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Good reminder here that with rapidly accelerating AI progress, you should likely be building with a vision that contemplates at least a few orders of magnitude of capability improvement or token volume available to you.

The best opportunities right now are those where you can value to customers today with things that are barely only possible, but with a full mission that feels nearly impossible with today’s tech.

There are lots of products the require orders of magnitude more processing of data (and thus are barely economically viable ideas) or where model capabilities still are in their infancy relative to what’s needed to work. Best to be building for those scenarios.

目前最好的机会在于，您可以利用一些在现有技术条件下几乎不可能实现的功能，为客户创造价值，并完成一项看似不可能完成的任务。

许多产品需要处理的数据量级大幅提升（因此在经济上难以实现），或者模型能力相对于实际应用而言仍处于起步阶段。最好针对这些情况进行产品开发。

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: The AI jobs prediction so far is playing out the opposite of what many thought.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
The AI jobs prediction so far is playing out the opposite of what many thought.

The reason this is happening is because AI is bringing automation to areas that don’t have finite demand characteristics. AI allows companies to do far more than they could before, but agents still require human operators and oversight to generate value from them. 

And not only has AI not replaced many of the types of jobs that theoretically would have been most affected by AI - engineers or lawyers - but AI is also creating or growing entire categories of jobs across the economy. 

Cybersecurity, FDEs, agent operators, engineers in non-software domains, and tons of job categories are going to explode. It’s not clear if or when this trend will reverse because we keep discovering all new areas of demand that AI is going to open up.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 目前来看，人工智能就业预测的结果与许多人的预期恰恰相反。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
目前人工智能就业预测的发展趋势与许多人的预期截然相反。

造成这种情况的原因在于，人工智能正在将自动化引入那些需求并非无限增长的领域。人工智能使企业能够完成以往无法完成的工作，但智能体仍然需要人工操作和监督才能创造价值。

人工智能不仅没有取代那些理论上最易受影响的职业——例如工程师或律师——反而正在创造或拓展整个经济领域的新就业类别。

网络安全、功能开发工程师 (FDE)、智能体操作员、非软件领域的工程师以及众多其他就业类别都将迎来爆发式增长。目前尚不清楚这一趋势是否会逆转，以及何时逆转，因为我们不断发现人工智能将开辟的全新需求领域。
